scope: Own mocked cross-origin fixture; no real player, media or TV

checks.name: Shared URLs expose one neutral launch; distinct provider voice routes remain separate
Dialog uses real correlated sounds response labels with no active-track claim
D-pad and Tab remain in the parent audio dialog
Selection forwards exact returned value, ignores cleanup, closes only the menu and preserves media state
Reopening focuses the last requested item in this session; first Back closes the menu only
Wrong-origin/source and late replies after Back cannot populate a closed dialog
Six-second timeout and repeated error/retry preserve OK focus, suppress pending duplicate requests and recover explicitly
Busy and same-frame reload close the menu, invalidate old membership and keep focus in parent
Watch Back destroys iframe and source values never enter persisted library
